integrity: An explicit analytical proof and reproducible finite diagnostic script are supplied; the finite checks are not treated as universal or independent proof.
limitations: Finite coordinate-radius diagonal traces on Hilbert Hardy polydiscs and their kernel-matched disk target only; the critical-window uniformity is for fixed dimension and bounded parameter vectors. Independent mathematical and priority review have not occurred.
title: Contact-count Schatten law and Dirichlet boundary layer for anisotropic Hardy diagonal traces
